name: Smart Sky Solar
old_description: Smart Sky Solar, the best solar installation company in Illinois, offers both grounded and rooftop
about:
Smart Sky Solar is a solar installation company based in Schaumburg, Illinois. Founded in 2006, the firm has served Northern Illinois for nearly two decades. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and the founders are not named in available sources.

The company designs and installs custom solar energy systems for residential and commercial properties, including ground-mounted and rooftop arrays. It also integrates solar-powered EV charging stations and battery backup systems for outage protection. Smart Sky Solar handles system design, permitting, and assists customers with federal tax credits and local incentives. The company reports completing over 1,000 projects and serving more than 1,000 clients since inception.

Its customer base spans homeowners seeking to reduce electricity bills and businesses aiming to cut operational energy costs by 50–75 percent. The firm also serves property owners adding EV charging infrastructure. All work is focused within the Northern Illinois region.

Smart Sky Solar emphasizes a customer-centric approach, transparent pricing, and the use of environment-friendly equipment that avoids roof damage. The company cites its team of veteran installers and a mission to accelerate clean energy adoption as key differentiators. Core values include integrity, quality, innovation, customer satisfaction, and environmental responsibility.
